item.title: Missouri debates increasing rural highway speed to 75 mph
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Missouri drivers may soon be able to pick up the pace on rural highways. State Rep. Jamie Burger, R-Cape Girardeau, has pre-filed a bill for the 2026 legislative session that would increase the maximum speed limit on rural interstates from 70 to 75 mph. item.title: Peak of Quadrantid meteor shower expected tonight
item.description: The Quadrantid meteor shower reaches its peak overnight, offering a bright and fast-moving display of 40-60 meteors per hour, with the best viewing conditions being after midnight through dawn in a dark location away from city lights.

item.title: Weather turnaround returning rare winter warmth
item.description: After a cold and rainy Saturday, temperatures will rise into the 50s on Sunday and soar into the 60s on Monday, before rain returns on Thursday and cooler temperatures settle in for the following weekend.

item.title: ‘You Could Feel It’: Fireball Races Across St. Louis Sky During Meteor Shower
item.description: A bright fireball was seen streaking across the St. Louis sky, linked to the Quadrantid meteor shower which is currently reaching its peak and producing especially bright and fast-moving meteors.
